summary: Wooden RFID and NFC cards pair natural materials with contactless chip options for hotels, clubs, memberships and other programs that want a stronger eco aesthetic.
Bio-degradable real wood material, Free of BPA / PVC / lead / phthalates / latex & Toxic substances
Produced from natural timber Woody fragrance, Clear wood texture

faq.question: What are Wooden RFID and NFC Cards commonly used for?
faq.answer: Best for eco-conscious hotel key cards, membership cards, business cards, and hospitality credentials where natural material is part of the brand experience.

faq.question: Which chip, protocol, or frequency options are available for Wooden RFID and NFC Cards?
faq.answer: Chip: Mifare 1k, f08, Ntag 213, Icode 2,Ultralight or customized chip. Read Range: 2-5cm,1-6cm depend on rfid reader

faq.question: What material or form-factor options are available for Wooden RFID and NFC Cards?
faq.answer: Material: Black Walnut/Bamboo/Birch/Cherry/Beech/Basswood/Maple/Birch/Sapele etc Size: 85x54mm, 40x40mm,42x26mm or customized.
